A small fix for deep clean.

"clear all app caches" did nothing on Samsung phones. They leave out the Android screen that button opens, and apps aren't allowed to clear other apps' caches on their own. Now:

- if your phone skips that screen, potato tells you so instead of doing nothing
- new "one by one": potato opens each app with a big cache in turn, you tap storage, then clear cache, and come back for the next one. It counts what got cleared as you go
- one by one works without "all files access"
- on phones where clear all does work, you get a little note with how much went

If Android won't install this over 1.2, uninstall the old one first, then switch its accesses back on. Potato reads your screenshots again by itself.

Needs Android 11 or newer. Download octo-potato.apk below and open it on your phone.
